title: Live Feed Events
description: Notable events from the shared live feeds (subscribed, data changed, dropped, stopped, failed), for looking into cards that didn't update. Deleted after realtime_liveFeedEventRetentionDays (default 30).

event.description: SUBSCRIBED, RESUBSCRIBED, CHANGED, FINISHED, DROPPED, STOPPED or FAILED

userEmail.description: The user's email address, looked up from userId when they subscribed
